meta.name: Steam locomotive (2-6-0)
meta.description: A Mogul steam locomotive: crossheads, main rods and coupling rods quartered at 90° and driven from one axle.

parts.label: Frame
parts.description: Bar frame carrying the boiler, cylinders and axle boxes.

parts.label: Boiler
parts.description: Fire-tube boiler: hot gas from the firebox boils the water around the tubes.

parts.label: Smokebox
parts.description: Front chamber where exhaust steam drafts the fire up the chimney.

parts.label: Chimney
parts.description: Stack where exhaust steam and smoke leave in rhythmic chuffs.

parts.label: Steam dome
parts.description: Collects the driest steam at the top of the boiler for the regulator.

parts.label: Firebox
parts.description: Coal burns here; radiant heat makes most of the steam.

parts.label: Cab
parts.description: Crew shelter with the regulator, reverser and firehole door.

parts.label: Rail left
parts.description: Steel rail the flanged wheels ride on.

parts.description: Steel rail the flanged wheels ride on.

parts.label: Coupling rod L
parts.description: Ties the three drivers together so they turn as one.

parts.label: Steam cylinder L
parts.description: Double-acting: steam pushes the piston both ways, twice per revolution.

parts.label: Crosshead L
parts.description: Slides in the guides, joining piston rod to main rod.

parts.label: Piston rod L
parts.description: Carries piston thrust out of the cylinder to the crosshead.

parts.label: Piston L
parts.description: Driven by expanding steam, alternately from each side.

parts.label: Main rod L
parts.description: Transfers piston thrust to the main driver’s crank pin.

parts.label: Slide bars L
parts.description: Keep the crosshead moving in a straight line.

parts.label: Valve gear L
parts.description: Swinging link that times steam admission, a quarter turn ahead of the piston.
